record.question: On which date President Ram Nath Kovinth visited Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer C: 29th & 30th November 2017. The President’s original itinerary places the Mizoram leg on 29–30 November 2017: housing-complex inauguration in Aizawl on 29 November and Assembly address on 30 November before onward travel to Nagaland. The source’s Kovinth is a spelling error for Kovind. Historical/source note: The 29–30 November 2017 Mizoram leg; the complete multi-state tour was 28 November–1 December. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1511021. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
